decisions.reason: The Definition explicitly fixes W_1 as the closed-interval indicator but asserts no pointwise partition identity for P=1. Its final sentence refers to the P>=2 windows just defined; lem-ewald-pme-spline-alias-and-dft-normalization step 2.2 states and proves partition unity only for P>=2, treating the integer-endpoint exceptions inside the P=2 convolution as measure zero. The assignment Definition also requires P>=2. Hence the value 2 at integer arguments of the W_1 translate sum contradicts no claim or consumer interface.

F6 was broader than the L^1 Statement quoted by its proof contract. Restricted the fact to that exact scaling formula; the only application uses f(y)=exp(-y^2), whose L^1 norm is sqrt(pi) by F3, so the kernel identities, inner-sphere flux signs, self expansion and derivative bounds remain unchanged. The supplier's proof step 6.1 in fact proves nonnegative substitution too, so this is a nonfatal citation-interface precision repair, not an invalid Gaussian calculation.

The proof established only the Poisson identity and absolute pointwise convergence, omitting the asserted local uniform convergence. Added step 1.2: on a compact |x|<=R, invertibility gives |x+An|>=c|n|/2 for large |n|, with summable product-Gaussian majorant (one-dimensional geometric comparison). Reciprocal absolute convergence at x=0 supplies an x-independent majorant since each character has modulus one. This closes the missing conclusion without changing the Statement or choice assumptions.

The explicitly scoped Example claims only the unit-charge case, which the constant-test proof correctly establishes: <u,-Delta 1>=0 but 4pi<rho,1>=4pi. The title is an accurate description of the obstruction, not an added hypothesis-free claim about arbitrary sources. Moreover the same displayed F1 calculation for any finite point configuration gives 0=4pi sum_i q_i, proving the title's general finite-source assertion directly. The example, prerequisite and page interface are sound.

The original real-J tail estimate is false: P=2 and J=1.99 retain a tail starting at |m|=2, and as u->0 its quotient by 2u^2 tends to sum_{m>=2}m^-2>1/1.99. Preserved every real threshold J>=1 by replacing J^(1-P) with floor(J)^(1-P). Step 1.2 now derives n^-P<=integral_{n-1}^n x^-P dx and sums from floor(J)+1; integer-index controllers and all exact aliases, conjugated D normalization and partition claims are unchanged.

F3 attributed a quantitative tail estimate to a supplier whose Statement proves convergence only; that unsupported estimate supplies the finite derivative certificates. Restricted F3 to convergence and proved the estimate in step 1.1 by summing m^-s<=integral_{m-1}^m x^-s dx. Also corrected the unspecified real truncation threshold to floor(J_0) in both remainders for J_0>=1, retaining real thresholds and unchanged integer calls. The tensor derivative sum for P>=3 and finite triangular-window P=2 knot bounds remain intact.

The Statement used alpha^-1, the screened kernel and T_3((4alpha^2)^-1, M) without defining or restricting alpha. Added the explicit hypothesis alpha>0, already required in Given and by both kernel/Ewald suppliers. Checked the six constants: shell index m>=floor(R) or floor(K)>=1 permits discarding inverse radial powers, Q and Q^2/2 give the potential/energy weights, and first derivatives yield the stated force constants. Collision-free local uniform derivative sums and symmetric image pairing justify the energy gradient.

Step 2.1 allowed a symmetric finite set containing zero, although c_k is defined only at k!=0; multiplying undefined c_0 by rho_0=0 does not define the sum. Restricted the proof's retained set to Z^3 minus {0}, matching the Ewald supplier, and explicitly supplied alpha>0 and Countable Choice in Given for that supplementary energy calculation. The Example's parity claim rho_k=1-(-1)^k1 is unchanged, including rho_0=0, and both retained sums agree term by term.

The assignment Definition and reciprocal theorem require a fixed alpha>0, but the Example supplied none although its c_k and energy depend on alpha. Added an arbitrary fixed alpha>0 to Example and Given. Checked neutral distinct sources, off-knot half-grid coordinates, signed nonzero symmetric injective +/-1 modes, and nonzero sinc(pi/4). At fixed alpha, differentiating the finite |z_k|^2 sum gives the negative energy gradient; differentiating C_M yields the printed corrected force, so the retained-mode error theorem applies under its existing hypotheses.
